title: Inspect one authorized Case Queue row without Workspace navigation
goal: Complete CAP-INV-101 §17 Queue → Inspector Class-0 selection using only the existing server-authorized Queue row, including saved views, filtering and pagination; no separate Inspector UI or Case mutation.
invariants: inspect_case opaque exact Case ID selects only an already source-authorized row of the SAME current Case Queue projection; no second query/search/authorization engine.
The current server session, independent Case/Incident/Finding ACLs, Shared Saved View, filters and page cursor are applied before Inspector selection.

Denied, stale-page or filtered-out selection emits generic error without unauthorized Case/Incident/Finding data; a readable stale Case may be inspected as stale but cannot automatically be opened for mutation.
Inspector HTTP returns a read-only row projection, NOT the canonical visual component or production UI; no new permissions, Command Work Queue or object mutation.
security_properties: No Case snapshot or nested Incident/Finding data reaches Inspector if the corresponding first-party read check denied it.
Unknown, duplicated or injection controls fail before session/provider. Selected Case cannot come from outside requested current page.
Provider revocation invalidates the authorized projection/cursor; raw candidate AccessDecision cannot grant read rights.

migration.rationale: Additional optional read-only HTTP Queue projection selection, no schema or store.

rollback.strategy: Remove optional inspect_case mode; old GET list/pagination, open_case/scroll, POST return and Saved Views unchanged.
verification: Existing native Queue/Workspace handoff tests unchanged

inputs: Canonical CAP-INV-101 §17 Queue -> Inspector selection; design-system Inspector owner remains Shared.
Exact frozen parent PR #146 SHA 6a7a265b473def439d19f2a43bc381feac6256df; engineering-kernel run 39309883879 SUCCESS, parent DRAFT.
outputs: Optional GET /case-queue?inspect_case=OPAQUE_CASE_ID returns only one current sanitized read-only Row, not the full Queue or a second owner object.
Same filters/sort, Shared view and `limit`/`cursor` select only currently visible rows. Existing open_case, POST return unaffected.
acceptance_tests: Real Go httptest: selected Case authorized, denied Case and denied Incident/Finding never leak, including partial Case flags.
Selection outside current page rejected; source revocation between page and inspection denies stale cursor.
Invalid/multiple selector or conflicting open_case/scroll or tenant/principal injections fail before session/provider; old Queue tests all green.

performance_budget.rationale: Reuse existing <=5000 owner authorization and <=100 page projection, no second owner traversal or new store.

definition_of_ready: Parent #146 implemented on published exact HEAD, with latest engineering-kernel success; L2/native approvals separate.
Read-only Case selection only; no Inspector UI implementation or OPEN-013 mutation.
definition_of_done: Publish exact base/head and meaningful Go native HTTP integration tests, obtain SHA-matched CI evidence.
One independent read-only L2 for material new inspector projection; no claim of product-wide acceptance or merging when ancestor PRs draft.
